quizTitle: Adverbs Modifying Adjectives — The Creative Industry

questions.question: The new album is ___ impressive — the production quality is top-notch.
Her new song is ___ popular on streaming platforms — it’s in the top ten globally.
The dancer was ___ exhausted after performing five nights in a row.
Critics said the documentary was ___ informative and beautifully shot.
The artist’s new exhibition is ___ unusual — it mixes sound, light, and scent.
The concert was ___ fantastic — the band played all their greatest hits.
The stage design was ___ perfect — every detail matched the director’s vision.
The audience was ___ surprised when the band suddenly changed style mid-concert.
Her voice sounded ___ different after years of touring.
